summary: Construct a boxed JavaScript String object.

target.notes: A boxed String is a String exotic object with [[StringData]], virtual indexed properties, length semantics, prototype behavior, and identity; do not collapse it to System.String.

semantics.mutation: object properties can be added; indexed string data properties have exotic constraints

caveats: A C# string cannot model boxed-string object identity or exotic indexed properties.

tests.name: boxed value is object
tests.input: const s = new String("x"); console.log(typeof s, s.valueOf());
tests.expected_behavior: typeof is object and valueOf is x
